root_causes.cause: File25 validated_redirect_map accepted arbitrary root/auth/infrastructure WordPress paths as from URL and could activate redirects for homepage, wp-login, wp-admin, wp-json, wp-cron or XMLRPC despite migration requiring old public profiles only.
root_causes.fix: Refuse root and protected WordPress core/auth/infrastructure paths, including subdirectory deployment. Preserve valid retired profile route redirects.

root_causes.cause: Migration validator detected exact same-route and duplicate source but did not compare destinations to OTHER source routes, allowing two-hop chains and cycles. No slash/query equivalence tests.
root_causes.fix: After validating map, compare normalized destination path with all normalized source paths, mark collision and block dry-run for any internal map chain/cycle; preserve independent valid maps.
